featured_reviews.name: Annoda Vinod
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered from lunch from Heroti for around 7 months when we were new to the place and were setting up our home. The food was really delicious, homemade and was sufficient for 2 people. The delivery service was on time and never missed a single delivery. They have very flexible plans and are very accommodating when it comes to adjusting the dates of any meals. I would recommend their service to anyone who is looking for a healthy homely tasty meal.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Priyadarshi
featured_reviews.review_text: The best home made food that you can find in Mumbai and that too home delivered. The variety offered is simply amazing. As promised, no dish was repeated and each one of them was superb. People like us who have a hectic schedule and can't cook or order food every now and then, it is a life saver. The staff is very polite and courteous. Saw all necessary precautions taken during delivery. The food is neatly packed and is still warm after delivery. If you are missing home made food then this is the place. And it is very budget friendly.

featured_reviews.name: Prasant Tripathy

Food tastes very good and same like home cooked food.Their on time delivery is a plus point.
Rates are very reasonable and having tried lots of other similar services in the market,I don't think so anyone is providing this kind of quality food at such rates with on time home delivery.
Please keep up the good work.

I highly recommend this service to anyone looking for a convenient and healthy meal option that doesn't compromise on flavor.

Thumbs up Heroti 👍.

featured_reviews.name: Sheshadri Iyengar
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking to order home cooked food for my family and myself since we had grown sick of eating food ordered from hotels. Having done some research on tiffin services in the Borivali-Kandivali area, I decided to order food from Naivedya Tiffin and Catering. And I'm glad I did. The food they prepare is hygienic, subtly flavoured and doesn't overload your taste buds as hotel food does. They have a wide variety of vegetable recipes and so you can almost expect the menu to be unique every day of the week. The serving size of vegetables is generous and the food is fresh and hot when delivered. Also, the food arrives neatly packed and is satiating. The team at this establishment is very professional and on the few occasions that I did request earlier than usual delivery of food, they ensured my request was accommodated. If you are looking to order food that is consistently tasty, nutritious, hygienic and delivered on time, look no further than Naivedya Tiffin and Catering.

Their company’s name suits them. Mom’s Kitchen. Agar aap maa ke haath ka khana Miss karte hai to Yaha se tiffin jarur mangvaiye. Here’s what I loved about Mom’s kitchen.

1. Variety of Menu to choose from. You have so many options in jain/non jain. They also make very good snacks like Ragda Patties, Paav Bhaji, Dabeli

2. Inka khaana khane se acidity bilkul nahi hoti. I suffer from sensitive stomach. Whenever I eat outside street food like Paav bhaji/Ragda Patties I end up terrible case of acidity. I used to be scared of eating outside food. But thanks to Moms kitchen now I can safely eat all my fav street food.

3. They treat their customers just like a mother will treat its child. Once I had to go to a meeting and required them to deliver me food very early. Almost 3 hours earlier than my normal time. And they did deliver it as they didn’t want me to skip my lunch. I was touched by this gesture.

They are doing great work and are very hard working people. I pray to god that their business keeps growing. Thank you moms kitchen.
